pitches.logline: Lasha drives up a mountain road to a village guesthouse. His map needs internet and freezes right before a fork, so he keeps guessing wrong.
pitches.hook: Close on the dash holder: the map on his phone stops dead with a grey spinning wheel just as the fork comes up. Lasha slaps the wheel and yells at it.

pitches.logline: Two friends climb a mountain road. The passenger is sure the trip is over when the phone loses signal, but the Georgian voice keeps talking.
pitches.hook: Nini's own phone in her hands: the loading circle spins and spins, an error buzz, she throws her head back against the seat.

pitches.logline: Giorgi drives his own car to his dad's mountain village and swears on the phone he knows the way. The call drops, the map dies, and every turn looks the same.
pitches.hook: Dad's voice through the car speaker; Giorgi starts boasting, the call cuts mid-word with a buzz.

treatment.logline: Giorgi drives his red hatchback up to his dad's mountain village and boasts on the phone that he knows the way. The call drops, the map freezes, and he gets lost.
treatment.hero: Giorgi and his red hatchback, on one mountain road from the last town up to the village
treatment.obstacle: No signal in the mountains: the call drops and his online map freezes at the forks

hook.event: Dad calls through the car's speakers, the call on the dash screen; Giorgi boasts that he knows the way

act1: The call drops: the signal bars fall to none, dad's last words a tease
The map freezes at the first fork; he picks left by feel. Wrong
The next turn ends at a dry-stone wall: a dead end, and he backs out slowly on a narrow ledge
treatment.turn: He kills the engine: a held beat, then black

reveal.what: Out of the black the phone rises slowly into the light: Vinari, then its navigator

screens.step: the route starts: Nelson says the next turn in Georgian, offline
at the fork it tells which side to keep

treatment.payoff: At the village at dusk dad calls again, „მიხვედი, ბოთეო?“; Giorgi, calm: he made it, Nelson knew the way
treatment.signature: The red hatchback climbs the slope while a tall altitude gauge beside it rises past 1500 to 2000, the mark ringing as the voice says it
